entries.summary: 读取 UTF-8 字符串并显式验证编码。
entries.code:
begin
  text = File.read("notes.txt", encoding: "UTF-8")
  raise EncodingError, "Invalid UTF-8" unless text.valid_encoding?
  puts text
rescue SystemCallError, IOError, EncodingError => error
  abort error.message
end

entries.summary: 读取字节并验证其为 UTF-8 文本。
entries.code:
<?php
$text = file_get_contents("notes.txt");
if ($text === false) throw new RuntimeException("Read failed");
if (!mb_check_encoding($text, "UTF-8")) {
    throw new RuntimeException("Invalid UTF-8");
}
echo $text;

try:
    value = json.loads('{"name":"Ada","count":2}')
    encoded = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
    print(encoded)
except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
    raise SystemExit(str(error))

entries.summary: 通过 TLS 发起 GET，检查成功状态并报告失败。
entries.code:
require "net/http"
begin
  uri = URI("https://example.com/")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port,
    use_ssl: true, open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 10) do |http|
    http.get(uri.request_uri)
  end
  raise "HTTP #{response.code}" unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
  puts response.body
rescue StandardError => error
  abort error.message
end

entries.summary: 使用 cURL，区分传输失败与 HTTP 失败状态。
entries.code:
<?php
$ch = curl_init("https://example.com/");
if ($ch === false) throw new RuntimeException("cURL init failed");
if (!curl_setopt_array($ch, [CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 10])) {
    throw new RuntimeException("cURL configuration failed");
}
$body = curl_exec($ch);
if ($body === false) throw new RuntimeException(curl_error($ch));
$status = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
if ($status < 200 || $status >= 300) throw new RuntimeException("HTTP $status");
echo $body;
